name: TestDriveBookingManager
tagline: Book every demonstrator without clashes, hand over the keys by the rules and turn each test drive into a follow-up.
description: A complete dealer test-drive app: a demo-vehicle schedule with clash and buffer checks, a drive board from request to outcome, licence, agreement and odometer check-out, return with distance and lateness, hot/warm follow-ups, demo-fleet utilisation and show-rate and conversion KPIs – in one Power Apps code component for Canvas, Model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Day schedule per demonstrator – click a free slot to book
Return with distance, lateness and condition note
Outcome with required follow-up for hot and warm leads
Overdue, late start, no-show, missing documents and excess distance flags
Show rate, conversion by model, source and salesperson
Bulk confirm, status, assignment, export and delete with Undo
Phone layout with bottom bar and agenda
controlType: standard (2 controls: data-set + Power Pages field)
